acs.text: WHEN a signed-in person presses Start a room (on the home rail, the rooms page, or an empty state) THE SYSTEM SHALL ask for a name (required, at most 120 characters, Start disabled while it is blank), create the room with `POST /api/v1/rooms`, and open its lobby, where the person is the owner; a failed create SHALL keep the dialog open and say "The room could not be created."; Cancel or Escape SHALL close it and return focus to the button

WHEN a signed-in person opens `/social/rooms` (social's navigation has a Rooms item) THE SYSTEM SHALL list every room they are a member of from `GET /api/v1/rooms`, newest first, each with its title, "Owner" or "Member", and a link to its lobby, plus Start a room; with none it SHALL say "You are not in any room yet."; signed out it SHALL ask them to sign in

WHEN a member opens a room's lobby THE SYSTEM SHALL show "Invite people" with the room's full link, Copy (announcing "Copied") and the Share menu, and say whether the viewer owns the room or is a member
scenarios: AC-003 inviting people from the lobby

acs.text: WHEN the owner renames the room in the lobby's room settings THE SYSTEM SHALL save it with `PATCH /api/v1/rooms/:id` and show the new title; Save SHALL be disabled for a blank name and a failure SHALL say "The name could not be saved."

WHEN the owner presses Delete room THE SYSTEM SHALL ask "Delete “Title”? Its recordings will be deleted too, and no one will be able to open it." and, on Delete, close any session of that room in this browser, delete it with `DELETE /api/v1/rooms/:id`, and open `/social/rooms` saying "“Title” was deleted."

WHEN a member who is not the owner presses Leave room THE SYSTEM SHALL ask "Leave “Title”? You can come back with its link." and, on Leave, close any session of that room in this browser, leave with `DELETE /api/v1/rooms/:id/members/me`, and open `/social/rooms` saying "You left “Title”."; the owner SHALL not be offered Leave
WHEN the home rail is shown to a signed-in person THE SYSTEM SHALL offer Start a room and a link to all their rooms; WHEN a recording's page is shown THE SYSTEM SHALL link back to its room's lobby
